reason: A DeepSeek Web client interface plugin that provides one-click and keyboard-based collapsing of expanded conversation sections, with pinned labels for sections that scroll out of view.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Web 客户端提供一键或快捷键收起所有展开的思考行、工具卡片等会话区块，并在区块滑出视野时显示可点击的顶部标签。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Web client plugin that collapses expanded conversation sections with one click or a customizable hotkey and shows clickable labels for sections scrolled out of view.

capabilities: Modifies the host web client DOM to add collapse controls and pinned disclosure labels
Observes conversation UI state and scroll position
Persists the shortcut configuration in browser localStorage
